patch_description: Two targeted improvements: (1) Replace the row-by-row dense LP construction (Python loops appending ~325 dense rows, evaluated once per search step) with a fully vectorized sparse-matrix build using triu_indices — this drastically cuts per-solve cost, letting many more search steps fit in the same wall-clock time. (2) Restructure the time budget: run 3 cheap starts (best base layout plus two ±0.005 jittered variants) with short ~0.45s anneals each, then spend the remaining budget on a long refinement of the winner. Extend the total deadline from 1.2s to 2.3s since eval_time was only 1.76s and prior Gen-2 showed the scoring tolerates ~2.5s. Cheap variants of the strong base (not diverse layouts) follow the Gen-8 lesson.
